def read_registry():
    p=LIB/'models.json'
    rows=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if p.exists() else []
    configuration=ROOT/'combined-app.json'
    if configuration.exists():
        settings=json.loads(configuration.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
        if settings.get('worktree'):
            worktree=(ROOT/settings['worktree']).resolve()
            manifest=worktree/'data/local_model_library/library.json'
            models=json.loads(manifest.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))['models']
            for row in rows:
                if row.get('reference') or row['id'] not in models:continue
                entry=models[row['id']]
                variants=entry.get('variants',{})
                asset=variants.get('post') or variants.get('pre')
                if not asset:continue
                path=(manifest.parent/asset['path']).resolve()
                if not path.is_file():raise ValueError('Worktree model is missing: '+str(path))
                row.update(input=str(path),name=entry.get('name',row['name']),
                           kind=path.suffix[1:].lower(),source_label='Active worktree: '+str(path))
    return rows
